typography.font_pairings: Unbounded for high-impact neon headings, Outfit for highly legible, modern geometric body text.

cards.base: bg-[#0D0D14] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden relative group

buttons.primary: bg-[#00E5FF] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-8 py-4 rounded-full hover:bg-white hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,229,255,0.6)] transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: border border-white/20 text-white font-medium px-8 py-4 rounded-full hover:border-[#FF007F] hover:text-[#FF007F] hover:bg-[#FF007F]/10 transition-all duration-300

header.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5 transition-all

floating_messenger.style: fixed bottom-8 right-8 z-50 w-16 h-16 bg-[#FF007F] text-white rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(255,0,127,0.4)] hover:scale-110 transition-transform cursor-pointer

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Elements should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and cast a neon colored ambient shadow on hover.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight upward translation (framer-motion opacity: 0 -> 1, y: 20 -> 0).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_effects: Use parallax on background images. Large typography should use text reveal animations on scroll.
motion_and_interactions.soundwaves: Use CSS keyframe animations (scale-y) on thin vertical bars to simulate equalizer/soundwaves in the hero section.

hero_background.description: Abstract pink/neon lines against dark space. Use with black gradient overlay (bg-black/60) to ensure text legibility.

event_crowd_laser.description: Electrifying concert with laser lights. Perfect for the Upcoming Events or Gallery hero.

featured_dj_1.description: DJ in black crew neck playing mixer. Use in Featured DJs cards.

featured_dj_2.description: DJ playing music in vibrant nightclub. Use in Featured DJs cards.

club_interior.description: Sleek, modern bar/club counter with blue neon. Use as background for Memberships or Booking Section.

party_crowd.description: Crowd partying with red/pink stage lights. Use in Gallery grid.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout sections (Hero, Gallery, Services) to ensure full creative control over overlapping grids and bento boxes.

Use pure Shadcn UI ONLY for the Booking Form, Member Login Dialog, and Admin Dashboard components (Data Tables, Inputs, Modals). Customize the Shadcn component borders to match border-white/10 and bg-[#0D0D14].
Install Google Fonts: 'Unbounded' (Headings) and 'Outfit' (Body). Do NOT use Inter.
Implement an animated CSS equalizer/soundwave effect behind the main Hero tagline.
Strictly follow the color hex codes. No pure white backgrounds anywhere in the design. Dark mode is permanent.
Ensure the sticky header has 'backdrop-blur-xl' and 'bg-black/50' so scrolling content is blurred underneath.
